cases.name: Campus Perimeter Monitoring
cases.description: Design a locally managed firewall and network monitoring platform for a college campus. It must segment student, staff, laboratory, guest, and administration networks; centralize security events; alert campus IT; and continue essential filtering during an internet outage.

clarification_rules.answer: Approximately 8,000 users, 12,000 devices, 40 buildings, and two data centers are in scope.
Keep searchable security logs for 180 days and archived audit records for one year.
Filtering must continue locally during WAN outages, with a four-hour recovery objective for central monitoring.
Campus IT administrators operate the service; use role-based access, encrypted management traffic, nightly configuration backups, and staged deployment.

cases.name: University Research Data Protection
cases.description: Create a cybersecurity requirements specification for a university research-data platform holding controlled research data. Researchers, principal investigators, ethics staff, and security administrators need role-based access. The platform must produce tamper-evident audit records, retain them for seven years, encrypt transfers and storage, and support incident investigation without exposing research content.

clarification_rules.answer: Tamper-evident access and administrative audit records must be retained for seven years and remain searchable for investigations.
Researchers receive least-privilege project access approved by principal investigators; ethics and security reviewers have separate read-only oversight roles.
Use encrypted daily backups, a four-hour recovery objective, and annual restoration tests.
About 2,000 researchers and 400 active projects are in scope; all data stays on university-managed infrastructure and every privileged action requires MFA.

cases.name: Regional Clinic Zero Trust
cases.description: Specify a local-first zero-trust access service for a regional clinic network. It must protect clinical workstations, medical devices, administrative systems, and remote support sessions while preserving emergency care workflows and recording privileged access for review.

clarification_rules.answer: The deployment covers six clinics, 900 staff accounts, 1,400 managed endpoints, and 350 medical devices.
Emergency clinical access must remain available during identity-service outages and be reviewed within 24 hours; target recovery is two hours.
Retain privileged-access and emergency-access audit records for six years with integrity verification.
Require MFA for staff and vendors, isolate unmanaged medical devices, approve vendor sessions, and keep patient data on clinic-managed systems.

cases.name: Industrial Network Segmentation
cases.description: Define requirements for passive monitoring and secure segmentation of a water utility industrial network. The solution covers control centers, treatment plants, engineering workstations, operator stations, historians, and vendor maintenance paths. It must not actively scan or disrupt operational controllers.

clarification_rules.answer: There are two control centers, eight treatment sites, about 600 operational assets, and 60 engineering or operator workstations.
Vendor access is time-limited, MFA-protected, approved by operations, recorded, and routed through a monitored jump host.
Monitoring failure must not affect control traffic; configuration recovery is required within four hours.
Use passive sensors only, enforce control-zone conduits, retain events for one year, and deploy changes during approved maintenance windows.

cases.name: Branch Secure Connectivity
cases.description: Produce an SRS for secure connectivity across 25 company branches and one headquarters. The system must provide encrypted site-to-site communication, separate corporate, voice, guest, and management traffic, fail over between two carriers, centralize policy, and give operations measurable service health without cloud dependencies.

clarification_rules.answer: Each branch supports up to 150 users; business traffic requires under 100 ms inter-site latency and voice requires under 150 ms.
Automatic carrier failover must complete within 60 seconds, with no single gateway failure at headquarters.
Keep configuration changes and security events searchable for 180 days and archive them for one year.
Network operations and security teams use separate roles with MFA; all controllers, telemetry, and backups remain on company-managed infrastructure.
